description: Self-authored JSON Schema tuple-array corpus (docs/design/json-tuple-arrays.md). Each case gives the JSON Schema and the model it imports to; accepted instances with their instance trees and, when it differs from the wire, the normalized output; rejected instances with the error kind, the failing node and the one-based tuple position of the outermost positional error (null when the error is not inside a position); and write-only instance trees. codec_cases and codec_refusal_cases are model-only shapes no JSON Schema imports to.

rejected.note: a tuple is an array, not an object

write_only.note: a missing field is an absent position
positions use the ordinary normalization for array items
root rows refuse a non-repeating frame root
every position absent writes an empty tuple
a non-empty tail requires every position
a Null tail is an empty tail

rejected.note: tuples in path are not nullable

write_only.note: a Null frame property is absent
a present frame with every position absent writes []

rejected.note: an object member is not nullable

codec_cases.note: A recursive reference that does not pass through a position expands normally.
